C17 and C05 share the resignation-and-commendation function, but their language and sequencing are less closely aligned.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Because of those urgent personal considerations about which you have spoken to me so many times, I accept your resignation effective at the close of business on March thirty-first. For all that you have done in your country's behalf... I tender you heartfelt assurance of my gratitude and appreciation.","parent_excerpt":"It is also due to your foresight... Every American farmer can bear witness to the benefits which have accrued from your administration... Gratefully and sincerely yours","explanation":"Both emphasize foresight, describe national benefits from the official's administration, and close with unusually explicit gratitude."}]}
